shell_commands: git --no-pager log -n 5 --oneline && git status -sb && command -v lore-query-trace || true
ls -d node_modules/ajv 2>/dev/null || echo "ajv not installed"; npm config get registry
npm version minor --no-git-tag-version --ignore-scripts && npm install --save --ignore-scripts --silent ajv
git --no-pager diff package.json && echo "--- ajv/package.json ---" && cat node_modules/ajv/package.json && echo "--- ajv.d.ts tail ---" && tail -n 25 node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts
node --input-type=module -e "import {Ajv} from 'ajv'; const a = new Ajv({strict: false, validateFormats: false}); console.log(typeof Ajv, typeof a.compile);"

node --input-type=module -e "import {Ajv} from 'ajv'; const ajv = new Ajv({strict: false, validateFormats: false, allErrors: true, addUsedSchema: false}); const v1 = ajv.compile({\$id: 'same', type: 'object'}); const v2 = ajv.compile({\$id: 'same', type: 'object'}); console.log(typeof v1, typeof v2);"

node --input-type=module -e "import {Ajv} from 'ajv'; const ajv = new Ajv({strict: false, validateFormats: false, allErrors: true, addUsedSchema: false}); try { ajv.compile({type: 'not-a-valid-type'}); console.log('did not throw'); } catch (e) { console.log('threw:', e.message); }"

npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts

git add .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "feat(tools): compile static schema on register" -m "Refs #37" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb
